final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS alb_tp_avg, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_pt_avg FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp_avg) AS alb_tp_sex_avg, AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS aptt_pt_sex_avg FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(aptt_pt_sex_avg) OVER () AS mean_sex_aptt_pt FROM sex_avgs) SELECT AVG(alb_tp_sex_avg) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(aptt_pt_sex_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(aptt_pt_sex_avg - mean_sex_aptt_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_minus_pt FROM scored WHERE aptt_pt_sex_avg > mean_sex_aptt_pt
